Name: Custom Prizes for Chronic Restarters
Author: Lycanthropire
Description:
[center]I am a [i]horribly [/i]chronic restarter, especially recently as I've been playtesting a ton of mods.[/center]
[center]Because of that, the initial early-game grind has become so tedious it almost makes me not want to play anymore. [i]Almost[/i].[/center]
[center]I also have a TON of large expansions and NPCs, so repeatedly gaining friendship with them all is [i]very [/i]tedious,[/center]
[center]and grinding for some of the harder end-game stuff is also not my favorite thing to do....[/center]
[center]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][b][i]But [/i][/b]I don't like just spawning in stuff with the item spawner![/b][/center]
[center]So, I made this content pack that changes ALL the prizes in Mayor Lewis' Prize Machine![/center]
[center]
[/center]
[center]Now I at least have to accumulate prize tickets before I can get my cheaty-cheat stuff, which I feel is a [i]little [/i]more fair![/center]
[center][/center]
[center]
[/center]
[center][size=4][b]This is probably [i]still [/i][/b][b]too cheaty and unbalanced for most folks[/b], but I figured I'd share it anyways. <3[/size][/center]
[center]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=2][img]https://i.imgur.com/bFCqrgi.gif[/img][/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Huge thanks to [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Tomokisan1][size=2]Tomokisan1[/size][/url][size=2] for their detailed explanations both in their description and in[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]their comments section on how to make a content pack for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24982]Custom Prizes[/url] mod![/size][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/bFCqrgi.gif[/img][/center]
[center]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Please feel free to edit this content pack to your hearts content, use it as a base for your own, etc.[/center]
[center]Credit to me is appreciated, but [i]not required[/i]! <3[/center]
[center]Tomokisan1 did basically all the work though, so [i]please DO [/i]make sure to credit them, and give them their well-deserved Endorsement![/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]

[center][size=1]Note: I have several mods installed that make some of these prizes make more sense in my own playthroughs![/size][/center]
[center][size=1]For instance, I have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]one[/url] that makes it so Ancient Fruit and Sweet Gem Berry cannot be put into the Seedmaker,[/size][/center]
[center][size=1]so getting those seeds from the prize machine is [u]still cheaty[/u], but isn't [i]quite [/i]as cheaty as it would be otherwise![/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=1]If you use this content pack as-is in your own saves, it is at your own risk, and your own experience may vary![/size][/center]

Downloads.Description:
Just drag and drop into your mod folder, like you do!
Don't forget you need the required framework, else this will do nothing!

I am not making mod manager download available because it breaks stuff too often, sorry!
